gates.evidence: The proposal targets the paywall surface (s03) which provides Janitor Plus information, not specific character-chat content.
The reward is a time-boxed entitlement (30 minutes of enhanced memory) for playing a 15-second mini-game, not for clicking or installing.
The copy 'Not ready yet?' is a neutral, polite transition; it does not employ confirmation-shaming or threat-based framing.
The user must tap the CTA 'Play to try' to opt-in to the rewarded experience.
The reward (30 minutes of 5x context) and action (15-second game) are explicitly stated in the offer body.
The offer includes a clear 'No thanks' button and explicitly preserves the paid/sign-up path as the primary option.
The proposal is gated to the paywall surface (s03), outside of the conversational AI flow.
The eligibility rules explicitly restrict offers to non-payers only, excluding subscribers.

scores.evidence: The offer triggers exactly when a user dismisses the paywall for memory/priority features ('More memory for long chats.'), providing a direct trial of the blocked benefit.
It integrates naturally as a 'trial' sample rather than a generic interruption; it requires no removal of existing features.
It is gated strictly to decliners, capped at once a day, and uses a time-boxed trial rather than a permanent unlock.
COGS is $0 as this is an entitlement toggle (memory/priority) rather than a per-message token expense; it is highly profitable compared to the $0.009–0.015 revenue per view.
Triggered by frequent wall interactions (m1, reach=frequent), ensuring a high number of relevant users see the offer.
Standard implementation (SIM-RWD, button, min 15s) using standard SDK components.
Uses the app's exact entitlements ('5x context for better memory', 'Priority routing') and correctly identifies surface s03.
Strictly limited to 1 per day, avoiding nag-loops.
Includes a 10% user-level holdout and monitors relevant conversion guardrails.

parsed.topConcern: None; this is a highly optimized, safe, and native rewarded ad pattern (TAX-10) for a subscription-gated AI app.
